trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done — it has no task of its own. Work through the roadmap in this guide and it arrives last, right after A Long Road. There are no online or DLC trophies, so everything is earned in single-player (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 and it pops. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss — this is the first story trophy most players will earn (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic at the end of Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it actually pops after the first mission of Chapter 2, “What’s in the Bag?”, so do not worry if it does not appear the moment Chapter 1 ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic at the end of Chapter 2. PowerPyx notes it pops after the first mission of Chapter 3, “Welcome to Vice City”, so a short delay past the chapter’s end is normal.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic at the end of Chapter 3. Per PowerPyx it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, “Ocean Beach” and “Another Life”.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic at the end of Chapter 4, after the chapter’s final mission, “Starting From Zero” (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic gold for finishing the final mission — the same “Starting From Zero” mission that closes Chapter 4 (PowerPyx). No extra requirement, and it is the only gold trophy that is hidden.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. Just play the story and it comes (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing Child’s Play, a Chapter 4 mission (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing Headliners, a Chapter 4 mission (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 mission (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for completing Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 mission (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The big one, and the hardest trophy on the list: reach 100% completion. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts (PowerPyx). The thresholds are forgiving — closer to 60% of true completion: scan 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of the 255 animals, finish 70 of the 80 challenges, and only some collectible types in part. Nothing on the checklist is missable, so it is all doable in free-roam after the credits. PSN tracks this one as a count to 100.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts (300 are needed for 100%). Four kinds count: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps (PowerPyx). Mix and match — under-the-bridge flights are the quickest. Track progress by region in Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt (PowerPyx). Check Progress > Activities to see which types you have done; most come naturally while working on other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx has a dedicated guide to all 12 locations and the 42 golds. Gold medals here are also needed for 100% completion, so this is a checklist trophy as well as a silver.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. There are 42 drone races in total, and all 42 are needed for 100% completion (PowerPyx). One win per location is enough for the trophy itself.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations — winning the same race twice does not count (PowerPyx, GTA Zone). Races, drone races and race challenges all feed the total; PowerPyx lists all 40 locations.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission “Feng Shui”, where you meet Cal, he texts you a fishing spot marked with a purple icon on the map (PowerPyx). Follow Cal’s fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck is at arcade machines around the world (PowerPyx). You must reach the end of the game; beating every challenge inside it is not required.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy’s questline, which is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and then texts her home address in Belville (PowerPyx). Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton’s treasure-diving questline. It starts in Chapter 1 after the mission “Island Dreams”: Kenton calls and is marked “KR” in Key Lento (PowerPyx). He marks shipwrecks with purple chest icons — find the treasure with the metal detector, bring it back, and clear 7 shipwrecks in total. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3, so nothing is missable. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy’s five jobs, starting at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission “Coffee Break” (PowerPyx): Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count — Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed (PowerPyx); Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not count toward this trophy. Track it in the trophy list itself. All strangers are still there in free-roam after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy’s Wish List. After the Chapter 3 mission “Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS” you get the Key Cloner and deliver the Zorrusso, then Randy wants 16 sports cars (PowerPyx). Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list (Map > Robberies > Randy’s Wish List) and drive them to his garage in west Vice City. Cars he marks appear in fixed spots, and new ones get marked as you deliver.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone’s questline, Jason-only, starting after the Chapter 3 mission “Here, Kitty Kitty” (PowerPyx). Purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City — destroy them in “Take Out Kitty Litter”, then Tyrone’s second quest, “Spin On This”, shuts the labs down. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, and meditating as both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts +2 (PowerPyx). THE missable one: the first meditation happens at Jason’s house in Chapter 1. After the mission “Down to Earth”, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept when she offers to show you how to meditate. It vanishes after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx could not yet confirm whether it is required for the trophy — so do it to be safe. The final meditation needs both characters playable together, which opens after Chapter 2’s “Coffee Break”. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His Jason-only questline starts after Chapter 2’s “Coffee Break”, when Bret texts you about “Veteran Hunted” in Lummox County (PowerPyx). He gives you the unique hunting rifle “Killtelligence SM-69” and marks hunting spots with purple icons; bring the animals back to him. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed (PowerPyx, GTA Zone).

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. PowerPyx has a locations guide for all 18 sets. Cards are a collectible type — pick up sets as you explore; you do not need all 18.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at any 100 locations — hold up on the D-pad and R1 to scan (PowerPyx). Landmarks (31), Curiosities (35), Sculptures (23) and No Flusher tags all count, and there are more than 100 in total, so any mix works.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (70 of 80 are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way). Track them under Progress > Challenges (PowerPyx). Most complete naturally while chasing other trophies; save the last few for the easiest ones left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. You need both characters together, which unlocks after Chapter 2’s “Coffee Break” (PowerPyx) — call your partner with right on the D-pad + Triangle. Build 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone; a fast sports bike helps, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good escape route because cops and the helicopter struggle to follow you there. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 bank-vault missions.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level — keep the flashing red/blue wanted level alive the whole time (PowerPyx). Call your partner, then hit three robbery targets (green icons) in a row; the pop can be delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop, and if it does not fire, hit a fourth. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well once Yasmani’s Chapter 3 jobs are done — rob a couple of items in each, and ideally break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app (hold up on the D-pad, then R1) — you only need to scan, not drive (PowerPyx). Stand on a busy road and scan the traffic. 200 of the 277 base models are needed for 100%, so this pops on the way. Check totals under Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming; it slows time and drains the purple focus bar) (PowerPyx). Buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, line up 5 enemies — gang-operation criminals work, while soldiers, police and civilians reportedly do not count — and drop them fast with a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier later in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA — it must be one connected to a boarding bridge, not one parked on the airfield (PowerPyx). The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge, board, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly about 1 km from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County (PowerPyx). The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot enemies until it pops. It brings a 3-star wanted level. PowerPyx also shows the run in a short video guide.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Yasmani’s Chapter 3 mission “Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs”, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors (PowerPyx). Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun instead of kicking it, find the safe-code note in the back room, and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape (all 8 are needed for 100%). First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission “That’s Where The Money Is…” — it teaches the method: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner along to carry a second bag (PowerPyx). After that, buy van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 a tip. Every vault robbery brings 4 stars, so keep a fast bike ready.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults counts — robbing a vault counts as robbing the truck (PowerPyx). Or earlier: block an armored truck near a bank, stick a bomb on its back door, and escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani’s shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map (PSN counts 52 areas). The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the whole map is visible (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs (all 39 operations are needed for 100%). Operations are marked with yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically through the story (PowerPyx). Track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not yet known. PowerPyx and GTA Zone both list this one as unconfirmed as of 19 November 2026 — the description (“Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach”) suggests a bar on Ocean Beach, but no guide has pinned the exact trigger yet. This guide will update when players crack it; do not trust any specific location until a guide confirms it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Not yet known. PowerPyx and GTA Zone both list it as unconfirmed as of 19 November 2026 — the description points to smashing out of a vehicle showroom, most likely through the window, but the exact showroom and trigger have not been confirmed by any guide yet.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn: steal all 3 key valuables — the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique “Gutterball Moreland 850” shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs) (PowerPyx). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. The location is marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission “Hit Kingpin Bowling”; if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time (PowerPyx). You can only work on this after Chapter 2’s “Coffee Break”, when you can switch between both characters. Buy a gym membership and always bring your partner (right on the D-pad + Triangle to call them) — while one works out, the other trains automatically. Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile (PSN tracks the count to 500). Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications) so a demon-face icon shows each time an action counts (PowerPyx). Clean robberies and stealth count as Professional; incapacitating without killing is Hardened; killing is Violent; mass killing is Psycho; keep going and you hit Irredeemable — which is permanent, so avoid it. It mostly happens passively while chasing other trophies.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Not yet known. PowerPyx lists it as unconfirmed, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue (“Second time’s the charm”), but no guide has confirmed the exact trigger as of 19 November 2026. GTA Zone agrees it is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Not yet known. PowerPyx lists it as unconfirmed, believed to be tied to a UFO questline (“What the hell just happened?”), but the exact trigger has not been confirmed by any guide as of 19 November 2026.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Not yet known. PowerPyx lists it as unconfirmed, believed to be about knocking enemies over with a melee attack while driving a motorcycle (“Bowl ’em over with a melee drive-by”), but no guide has confirmed the exact trigger as of 19 November 2026.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts — a running total, not all at once (PowerPyx). First finish the Chapter 3 mission “Credit Check” to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). Bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 a job.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, as a running total (PowerPyx). Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way — they are the most expensive things in the shops. It comes naturally over a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (about $160,000 in total; the 4 story garages do not count) (PowerPyx). They go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission “Daily Driver”, when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4, are the quickest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, which Moses installs on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission “Moses” (PowerPyx). You need free garage space first (see Little Boxes), then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay ’n’ Spray. Cheap cars and bikes keep the cost down.
